invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.20.0 preserves Parts 1–22, including the validated company-bound financial graph, canonical append-only SHA-256 audit ledger, eTIMS, international e-invoicing, recurring billing, dunning, portal, payments, credits, retainers, mobile-safe settings and visibility contracts, and adds Part 23 granular authorization without a tenant-schema bump: separate payment allocation/reconciliation/refund/reversal, credit issue/apply/refund/cancel, retainer, payment-plan, recurring-run, reminder/dunning, portal, currency/tax, eTIMS, international e-invoicing, audit-view and report-export authorities. Server guards accept granular-or-legacy grants during transition, the read model exposes matching capabilities, navigation/UI visibility follows those capabilities, and the module role catalog registers every new authority.
